purpose: Phase II-only eligibility sentence embedding cache for MSI (8GB RAM) handoff

full_cache.provenance: regenerated by us: keys = HINT/protocol_encode.collect_cleaned_sentence_set() over data/raw_data.csv (513,863 sentences); model dmis-lab/biobert-base-cased-v1.1 (= biobert_v1.1_pubmed of biobert-embedding 0.1.2); semantics = final encoder layer, mean over all tokens incl [CLS]/[SEP], token_type_ids=1, fp32, eval mode, no grad; numerical equivalence vs pytorch-pretrained-bert 0.6.2 verified max|d|<2e-6

subset_procedure: for each row of data/phase_II_{train,valid,test}.csv: split_protocol(criteria); collect result[0] and (if len==2) result[1] sentences — exactly the lookups protocol2feature performs; values copied by reference from full cache (unchanged tensors); keys sorted for deterministic pickle bytes
missing_sentence_behavior: identical to full cache: absent sentences -> protocol2feature zero vector via its `if sentence in sentence_2_vec` guard; missing count = 0
usage: place as data/sentence2embedding.pkl in the repo root on the target machine
